name: CA Immobilien Anlagen AG
summary: CA Immobilien Anlagen AG is a real estate company headquartered in Vienna with subsidiaries in Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic, Hungary and Serbia. The parent company of the Group is the listed CA Immobilien Anlagen Aktiengesellschaft, based in Vienna, whose main activity the strategic and operational management of its domestic and foreign subsidiaries. The individual branches operate as largely decentralized profit centers. As at December 31, 2024, the Group comprised a total of 139 companies with 254 employees.
